The Data Analyst - Operations & Capacity Planning produces accurate KPI dashboards, recurring operational reports, and warehouse and transportation capacity forecasts across Wintec programs and supply-chain functions. Reporting to the VP of Supply Chain Operations, the role applies approved reporting methods, verifies data quality, and escalates significant deviations and capacity risks.
 

**Role Objective**

Deliver reliable operational visibility and forward-looking analysis of warehouse space, throughput and trucking requirements. Improve the consistency of existing reports and forecasting tools while enabling Program Management, Freight and 3PL/Warehouse Operations to make informed decisions.

**About Ortelan**

Ortelan is an applied AI lab. We develop our own AI products, build and operate AI systems for organizations on their own data and infrastructure, and invest in early-stage companies. Each line of work informs the others. The systems we run for clients show us what our products need to do, and building products teaches us how to run a deployment.

**About the role**

Forward Deployed Engineers build the systems our clients run every day. You will work directly with client teams, connect to their data and infrastructure, and ship AI systems that hold up in production. Examples include an engineering assistant wired into a team’s codebase, a pricing model tested against years of sales history, and an assistant that supports representatives on live customer calls.

You will work closely with our product managers and data scientists, and you will stay with a system after launch. What you learn in the field goes back to the lab and into our products.

**In this role, you will**

* Build and ship AI systems on client data and infrastructure, in their cloud or on premises
* Work with client engineers and the people the system is meant to help, remotely and on site
* Connect models to the systems a client already runs, including databases, codebases, messaging and internal tools
* Test systems against the goals agreed with the client before they go live
* Work with client security teams on hosting, identity, permissions and data handling
* Monitor quality and cost in production and fix what breaks
* Turn repeated client problems into reusable tools for the rest of the lab

**You may be a good fit if you**

* Have 0 to 3 years of experience in software engineering, with work you can show or explain in depth
* Write production code in Python or TypeScript and are comfortable reading a codebase you didn’t write
* Have built something with language models and know where they fail
* Can explain a technical tradeoff to an engineer and to an executive
* Are willing to travel to client sites when a deployment calls for it
* Work well remotely and set your own direction

**Strong candidates may also have experience with**

* Deploying software on premises or in a customer’s own cloud
* Retrieval, evaluation, or agent systems in production
* Data engineering and working with messy enterprise data
* Early-stage companies or client-facing technical work

We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet every qualification listed here. We care most about what you have built.

**Location**

This role is remote within the United States. You will travel to client sites regularly, and you are welcome at our Salt Lake City office whenever you are nearby.

**Compensation**

The annual base salary range for this role is $0 to $150,000. Individual compensation is determined by job-related skills, experience and location. The role is also eligible for a performance bonus. We discuss specifics during the interview process.

Apply via LinkedIn. You can learn more about our work at ortelan.com.
